'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 Tom Frafjord DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Frafjord]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel}}
* '''Deck name:''' Guerilla TIEs
* '''Username:''' citizenScanty?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
